# cork-search-tray

Lays out the cork-header's search tray when it has more than a search form: a cork-search-form and a cork-search-common.

Add it as a child of the cork-header element. With only a form, put the cork-search-form directly in the header instead.

- Its children are assigned to its slots automatically by tag name, or by their slot attribute.
- Opening the tray focuses the form.
- Closing the tray calls onNavTrayHide() on each child that has it.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `headerComponentLabel` | `String` | Label for the tray, e.g. in the header's nav tray bar. Default: 'Search'. Attribute: header-component-label. |

## Slots

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `form` | Search form. A child [`cork-search-form`](../elements/cork-search-form.md) is assigned here automatically. |
| `common` | Common searches, shown below the form. A child [`cork-search-common`](../elements/cork-search-common.md) is assigned here automatically. |

## Methods

### focus(opts)

Focuses the form, or else the common searches. Called by cork-header when it opens the tray.
The children are slotted, so delegatesFocus on this element wouldn't reliably reach their controls.

| Param | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `opts` | `Object` | Focus options, passed on to the child's focus(). |

### onNavTrayHide()

Called by cork-header when its nav tray hides this element. Passes the call on to each child that has the method,
e.g. so the form clears its input.

## Examples

**Import**

```js
import '@ucd-lib/cork-theme/elements/cork-search-tray';

// or the class only, without registering the element:
import CorkSearchTray from '@ucd-lib/cork-theme/elements/cork-search-tray/cork-search-tray.js';
```

**Use**

```html
<cork-header>
  <cork-search-tray>
    <cork-search-form>
      <button name="news">News</button>
    </cork-search-form>
    <cork-search-common>
      <a href="/hours">Hours</a>
    </cork-search-common>
  </cork-search-tray>
</cork-header>
```
